Four ways to build AI systems

The chip

Electronics Engineering (VLSI Design and Technology)

Design a processor core and verify its logic. Suits students who enjoy precise work. Explore careers in chip design, verification and physical layout.

Explore VLSI Design and Technology

The device

Electronics and Computer Engineering

Design circuit boards, write firmware and run AI on a device. Suits students who enjoy electronics and computing. Explore careers in firmware and product engineering.

Explore Electronics and Computer Engineering

The machine

Robotics and Artificial Intelligence

Program machines to sense and move. Suits students who want to see their code control a robot. Explore careers in robotics, automation and machine perception.

Explore Robotics and Artificial Intelligence

The intelligence

CSE (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning)

Train models, test predictions and build software. Suits students who enjoy maths and programming. Explore careers in applied AI, machine learning and data science.

Explore CSE (AI and Machine Learning)

Management

BBA and MBA

Work alongside engineers to bring a product to market. Learn how to finance it, source its parts and reach customers, using data and AI to guide decisions.

BBA

3 or 4 years (proposed)

The Bachelor of Business Administration is an undergraduate route into business and management.

MBA

2 years

The Master of Business Administration is a postgraduate route into business and management.

Four specialisations

The four proposed specialisations apply to both degrees. Ask admissions which options are available at your preferred campus.

  • AI for Business

    Analyse business data and use AI to automate routine work and compare options.

  • Supply Chain and Operations Management

    Plan how to source parts, manufacture products and deliver them to customers.

  • AI for Marketing and Sales

    Use AI to identify customers, develop a brand and make sales decisions.

  • Entrepreneurship and New Ventures

    Find customers, set a price and assess funding and growth options for a venture.

See BBA and MBA programme details

For those who want the detail

Projects get more demanding each semester and lead to a final term of supervised engineering work. Practical assessments record the skills each student can demonstrate independently.
